question: How extensive is the uprooting power produced by this ritual application?
premises: Uprooting occurs quickly as a result of the rite
Even an immovable entity can be uprooted
Humans are implied to be easier to uproot than the immovable
inference: The rite quickly produces uprooting, even of the immovable, so how much more of humans.
plain_english: Uprooting would occur quickly, even of the immovable—what then of humans?
